name: IIMT
summary: IIMT, known in Chinese as Jicui Intelligent Manufacturing, develops robotics and intelligent manufacturing technology in Nanjing. Established in 2016 by the Jiangsu Industrial Technology Research Institute, Nanjing Jiangbei New Area and Professor Luo Minzhou’s team, the company develops platforms for industrial automation and embodied intelligence. Its Jizhi A1 combines a humanoid upper body with a mobile base for manipulation, research and human interaction.
